## VERDICTS ON OPEN FINDINGS

CONFIRM C0031 — `_block_is_hard` over-classifies any block containing common English words like "MUST", "ALWAYS", "DO NOT" in regular prose as HARD, preventing legitimate SOFT pruning. Verified by inspection: `" MUST "` appears in the upper-cased block `" YOU MUST PROVIDE EXAMPLES "` even though the surrounding packet is SOFT.

CONFIRM C0032 — `_split_packet_directives` treats uppercase-label lines (e.g. `VERIFIED: TRUE`) as block boundaries via `_DIRECTIVE_START_RE`'s `[A-Z][A-Z0-9 _/-]+:` branch, shattering metadata from its parent directive.

CONFIRM C0036 — `resolve_layer_conflicts` completeness gap. The conflict detector only covers 4 topic dimensions (verbosity, examples, rationale, table). Any other conflicting directives pass through undetected.

CONFIRM C0027 — Intra-packet pruning removes SOFT blocks from the end, assuming later = lower priority. No evidence this ordering invariant is enforced by any upstream producer.

EXTEND C0037 — The `_SYNONYMS` map in `_normalise_tokens` maps `"simple"→"concise"`, causing directives about simplification (e.g. "use simple language") to share tokens with directives about conciseness (e.g. "be concise in output"), feeding false positives into the dedup function beyond what the Jaccard/containment thresholds alone produce.
